settings.digit_mapping: All ten digits map to # in the radio component.
settings.unknown_character_handling: A ? ends the current training span; no n-gram crosses it.
settings.radio_smoothing: Add 0.01 to each of 27^4 collapsed four-gram cells, then normalize.
settings.digit_expansion: Distribute each radio class probability uniformly over the 10^k specific digit strings.
settings.score: Log10 of the equal probability mixture of the book model and expanded radio model.
